entities.summary: Óengus mac Fergusa was king of the Picts from 820 until 834. In Scottish historiography, he is associated with the veneration of Saint Andrew, the patron saint of Scotland, although this has not been proven. Óengus II was a monarchs & rulers (701 CE–834 CE).
